symptom: A production release committed successfully, but verify released rejected the installed offline bundle because its Product RUP Root was available only through the same-product Runtime Profile mapping.
whyGateMissed: Offline bundle and resolver tests verified Runtime Profile trust, while released-state tests supplied Product RUP roots directly and never exercised the bootstrap mapping written by bundle install.
earliestDetection: Install a production bundle whose publisher reuses its Product RUP Root as the Runtime Profile Root, then run released-state verification without an explicit --product-root override.
